GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 332.1 (15 Apr 47) GA
(SCAPIN - 1610)
APO 500
15 April 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Hoisting of Japanese National Flag.
1. There is no objection to the hoisting of the hosting of the Japanese national flag on 29 April 1947, as requested by C.L.O. No. 2523fPH) dated 9 April 1947.
2. Occupation troops will be informed of this matter.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
